name: linear-reg-5v
prompt: Build a regulated 5 V rail from a 12 V battery using a linear regulator, with input and output capacitors, powering a green indicator LED with a series resistor.
notes: The regulator value-parser landmine as its own case: a value written as a part number (e.g. "LM7805" or "AMS1117-5.0") is read by the engine as thousands of volts. The accuracy checker parses the regulator value the way the engine does and scores the distance from 5 V.
